identities: Immutable first terminal, immutable success terminal, immutable Provider-error terminal recorded distinctly.
durability: Separate success and Provider-error acknowledged flags; effective terminal evidence selects Provider error when present.
fatal_rule: A complete explicit Provider error after success supersedes its effective cause. Its new evidence cannot inherit the earlier success ACK.
tail_rule: Partial frames, timeout/cancel/transport termination cannot revoke a durably proven effective terminal.
